notes: All three are real model inferences through the local Magpie gateway; each was a single attempt, no automatic retry.
Models are subscription/quota-funded (WorkBuddy / Codex), not official-API cash; no cash settlement was performed (authoritative billing reconciliation remains S10).

Claude Code here is the pinned claude-agent-sdk / claude binary inside the claude-native image; the host has no standalone claude CLI.
